description: Oil and Gas Pipelines of Australia (series on data.gov.au) is a series of datasets listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This data set contains information on Oil and Gas pipeline infrastructure. This dataset has been converted from Microstation format used in a map "Petroleum Exploration and Development Titles" published annually in APRIL. Attributes have been added to comply with data standards and minor coding of line work has been achieved using annotation from the map. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 14 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are AU, National dataset, Petroleum Data, Petroleum and Coal Geology, Published_External. It offers 2 resource(s) in html, zip. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
